sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def glyph(r0,c0):
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def get_P0(): return glyph(52,13)
def wpos():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    return [ (n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in seg if n['color']=='W']
start=get_P0()
seq=[start]
print('start P0:', '\n'.join(start))
print('W at start:', wpos())
for i in range(12):
    action(['UP'], intent='explore')
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def g2(r0,c0):
        return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
    p0=g2(52,13)
    seq.append(p0)
    print(f'after UP {i+1}: P0=', ''.join(''.join(r) for r in p0), ' W=', wpos())
    if p0==start:
        print('CYCLE CLOSED after', i+1, 'UPs')
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
